name: walker-stall-flat-ground
note: The product walker, a 0.25 box driven at 0.4 units per second (0.00625 a quantum), alone on the product floor: on 23 of its 640 quanta it moves less than half a stride, first at 98 (3.20e-4). The quanta: 98 107 124 125 128 137 181 230 267 278 318 319 352 367 392 431 436 467 503 534 549 552 568. T4 recorded it in the product scene (harness/outcome.test.js, outcome 4). Saved at 97, before the first, with the solver image; the replay and the rerun from the image cross every stall. It replays green because the engine reproduces the stall exactly; the slice that fixes it changes these hashes and rewrites this bundle.
